pages.text: Tier tokens are the primary progression currency, used in tier-gated crafting. Four tiers: $(t1)T1$() (iron) - $(t2)T2$() (steel-blue) - $(t3)T3$() (amethyst) - $(t4)T4$() (gold). Token fragments drop from chests; 5 fragments = 1 full token.$(br2)$(bold)Sources:$() Structure chests, boss kills (1-4), gate quests (3-5), transmutation (8 lower = 1 higher).$(br2)$(bold)Uses:$() Tier-gated crafting stations, waystones, Class Altar, reforging tokens, advanced alloy recipes. Completing quest paths advances tiers automatically - tokens are for crafting, not advancement.
